note: Score each expected_behavior line independently. These are authored evaluations, not executed results.

scenarios.title: Stripe authority
scenarios.query: Implement subscription checkout and grant access after payment.
expected_behavior: Treats the webhook as payment authority rather than the redirect
Claims webhook idempotency before side effects
Reconciles provider state into the product database
Tests renewal, refund and out-of-order delivery paths

scenarios.title: Consent-safe purchase tracking
scenarios.query: Send one purchase to GA4, Google Ads and Meta from browser and server.
expected_behavior: Uses one stable event id across browser and server copies
Waits for confirmed payment rather than the thank-you page
Respects consent state and names degraded measurement

scenarios.title: Google account linking
scenarios.query: Add Google sign-in to an app that already has password accounts and also needs offline API access.
expected_behavior: Separates identity sign-in from server-side API authorization
Prevents automatic linking by unverified matching email alone
Stores and rotates refresh credentials server-side
Defines revocation, re-consent and error handling
